title: PV-MambaSeg: Geometry-Enhanced Vision Mamba With Omni-Local Scan for Photovoltaic Cell Defect Segmentation
mechanism: Vision Mamba with omni-local multi-direction scanning plus a global-local VSS block with multi-window aggregation and channel attention for irregular, arbitrarily oriented defects.
adaptation: If code is released, train at 512 px 1-ch on our 24 classes; multi-direction scan may follow long cracks across busbars. Needs Mamba CUDA kernels (install needs user OK).
min_experiment: Arm PV-MambaSeg 3 seeds vs house; mIoU_rob and crack relF1@2; kill if both below house.
evidence: R: claims highest mIoU on two real PV defect datasets with 2.77 M params and 0.78 GFLOPs; per-dataset numbers not retrieved; code 'will be made public', not found.
